main.description:
A live "now playing a game" status — one record per game currently being played, keyed by that game's own rkey.
Consider this record abandoned if staleAt >> now.
Be mindful of players' privacy preferences. Do not create this record
without consent from the owner to publish their live activity, and
consider what 'covert play' looks like in your app.

game.description: The game being played (link to a games.gamesgamesgamesgames.game record)

platform.description: The storefront/platform being used (link to a games.gamesgamesgamesgames.platform record)

state.description: The kind of session this is (eg. "Daily Challenge", "4-player game")

details.description:
The task being handled right now in the game
eg. "Level 5-2", "Ranked - Diamond II", "Turn 14 of 20"

id.description: An ID for this gaming session which will be the same for all players playing together

current.description: Count of players currently in the party

dids.description:
Who they are, including yourself, may be less than current count
eg. if some players don't have atproto accounts.
Be mindful of players' privacy preferences.
Ignore DIDs of players who don't also have
an equivalent record (use `id` to match)

max.description: Capacity, if there's a hard limit

party.description: Who's playing in this session (only for 'playing' activity)

playing.description:
Details only relevant if you're playing.
It's presence implies you're playing, not watching.

staleAt.description:
When this record should be considered abandoned.
Active sessions should update this regularly (eg. every 5 mins)
to a few minutes in the future.

via.description: The (unique) name of the client (game/site/app/etc) which wrote this record. Your app's domain is a good choice.
